questions.text: What is a solution?
options: A homogeneous mixture of two or more substances
A heterogeneous mixture where particles settle at the bottom
questions.correct: A homogeneous mixture of two or more substances

questions.text: In a sugar-water solution, which is the solute?
questions.correct: Sugar

questions.text: In a sugar-water solution, which is the solvent?
questions.correct: Water

questions.text: Why is water called the 'universal solvent'?
options: It dissolves more substances than any other liquid
It is denser than other liquids
questions.correct: It dissolves more substances than any other liquid

questions.text: Soda (softdrink) is an example of what type of solution?
questions.correct: Gas-in-liquid

questions.text: Air is best described as which type of solution?
questions.correct: Gas-in-gas

questions.text: Bronze (an alloy of copper and tin) is an example of what type of solution?
questions.correct: Solid-in-solid

questions.text: What is saturation?
options: The point where no more solute can dissolve in a solvent at a given temperature
When a solution is diluted with water
questions.correct: The point where no more solute can dissolve in a solvent at a given temperature

questions.text: What happens to a plant when grown in soil with very high salt concentration?
options: Water moves out of the plant roots due to osmotic stress, causing wilting
It grows faster because salt is a nutrient
questions.correct: Water moves out of the plant roots due to osmotic stress, causing wilting

questions.text: What is saltwater intrusion?
options: Seawater seeping into freshwater aquifers, making them salty and unusable
Adding salt to freshwater for drinking
questions.correct: Seawater seeping into freshwater aquifers, making them salty and unusable

questions.text: Which of the following is a MAJOR cause of saltwater intrusion in Philippine coastal areas?
options: Over-pumping of groundwater and rising sea levels due to climate change
Farmers adding too much salt to soil
questions.correct: Over-pumping of groundwater and rising sea levels due to climate change

questions.text: What does the GHS skull-and-crossbones symbol mean?
options: Acute toxicity — can cause death or serious harm
questions.correct: Acute toxicity — can cause death or serious harm

questions.text: What does the GHS flame symbol indicate?
options: The substance is flammable and easily catches fire
questions.correct: The substance is flammable and easily catches fire

questions.text: Which GHS symbol warns that a chemical can corrode skin or metals?
questions.correct: Corrosion (test tube dripping on surface)

questions.text: Why must acids and bases be stored separately?
options: They can react violently if they touch
questions.correct: They can react violently if they touch

questions.text: What is the BEST practice when handling chemicals at home?
options: Wear gloves, work in a well-ventilated area, and read the label
Work in a closed room to avoid drafts
Mix all cleaners to save time
Store them in food containers for easy access
questions.correct: Wear gloves, work in a well-ventilated area, and read the label

questions.text: What is the BEST way to dispose of leftover household chemicals?
options: Take them to a designated hazardous waste collection point following DENR guidelines
Pour them into the storm drain
Throw them in the regular trash
questions.correct: Take them to a designated hazardous waste collection point following DENR guidelines

questions.text: What is eutrophication?
options: Algal blooms caused by excess nutrients (phosphates) in water — kills fish
questions.correct: Algal blooms caused by excess nutrients (phosphates) in water — kills fish

questions.text: Which Philippine law specifically regulates toxic substances and hazardous waste?
Why is it important to properly dispose of chemical wastewater?
options: To protect aquatic ecosystems, prevent water contamination, and keep drinking water safe
To increase the volume of the ocean
questions.correct: To protect aquatic ecosystems, prevent water contamination, and keep drinking water safe
